prompt: Original horizontally scrolling Chinese fantasy RPG BACKGROUND ONLY in 1990s 16-bit pixel art, 16:9. scenes.prompt: A low Chinese wayside inn, warm amber wall, broad tiled roof and a pair of vermilion lanterns, beyond a paved trade road with blue-gray mountains at dusk.
An empty abandoned quarry behind the inn. Three immense warm ochre cut blocks, a tilted timber hoist silhouetted against a jade ridge, late afternoon.
Three sweeping horizontal bands of lime-green tea hedges, a narrow silver stream and one strong footbridge silhouette in a steep Chinese valley in spring.
A narrow turquoise waterfall dropping between two massive jade bluffs into a still round pool, dry fern bank and a crooked pine; sheltered blue shade.
A dry geode cleft in an exposed riverbed. Monumental diagonal ochre and amethyst bands of shale, three bold wedge-shaped mineral crystals.
A gently winding path along the eastern shore of a green lake, a single willow leaning over a curved red footbridge, broad reflections and distant karst.
Close view into a hidden mossy rock shelter framed by the broad looping roots of a pollarded willow beside an emerald lake. Muted warm stone.
Low exposed pebbly lakeshore, several very large round amber river stones, a tiny line of shallow pale-blue water, open sky and reeds at right.
A sunlit bamboo lane beside a distant traditional Chinese harbor. Bold bamboo columns at left, angular groups of leaves, two muted vermilion sails in the distance.
Narrow blue-gray north ridge above a sea of morning clouds. A prominent overhanging viewing rock on the right, a small lone windswept pine and long bands of cloud.
A craggy mountain arena before two massive fractured stone gateposts, a single torn russet clan banner and a low amber campfire pit, cool indigo cliffs.
